comparator.name: Law
comparator.sourceNotes: The revised current-entry curriculum is supported through Years 1 and 2 only (60+60 EC). The current study guide reserves the displayed third year for entrants in 2024 or earlier and says the revised third year will appear in 2027–2028. The OER's 150 compulsory/bound plus 30 free-choice allocation does not identify the missing course-level third year, so no outgoing modules or generic filler are added.
